title: Manager: small fixes left by task 058 (substitution inside a forced deletion, main-folder recommendation, orphaned pushes(), commit-message advice for builders)
item: Fix the minor problems review 058-1, review 058-2 and advisor 058-2 left in the deletion checks and the hook
motivation: None blocked task 58, but one lets a forced deletion of an unconfirmed branch through the hook, and one gives wrong advice in the run report.
notes: Review 058-2: (2) a forced deletion of a confirmed branch followed by $(echo owner-idea) is allowed, and bash also deletes owner-idea; refuse a forced deletion whose text holds $(, a backtick or $; (3) when the main folder has the branch checked out, superseded recommends git worktree remove on the main folder, which git refuses; it should say switch the main folder back (test_deletion.py asserts the wrong text); (4) pushes() in checks.py is now called by nothing; (5) commands/manage.md step 7 prescribes a double-quoted merge -m, so a title holding $ changes the subject; (6) the heredoc and -F advice is not in agents/builder.md, so builders' heredoc commits naming refused commands are refused mid-run; (7) the docs test checks only that strings appear; (8) SKILL.md rule 6 says two cases so far but lists four. Review 058-1: forced-deletion match misses abbreviated long options (--del --forc); the hook checks superseded in the event's cwd repo. Advisor 058-2: known holes needing -m inside another quoting context (echo ' -m " ...', bash -c with a single-quoted message inside double quotes, bash -cm); consider a refusal hint to use a plain quoted -m or -F. Outside: step 7 cleanup looks only at task/<id>* branches, never iterate branches or parked tasks' branches.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-17 from reviews 058-1 and 058-2 and advisor 058-2.
